items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1959-09-24
items.q: Some of them now, you catch that Morgan boy that's playing with Cab Callaway.

ctx.x: And some of the boys around Chicago, but I mean New York, that's playing saxophone right now. Some of them now, you catch that Morgan boy that's playing with Cab Callaway.
With Al Morgan. Al Morgan played a bass player.

Well, he left here and went to Chicago. And, oh, there was so many other fellas, you know what I mean, that played and played around here and all that kind of stuff, you know what I mean? But I just, it's like, I forget them.
